column1: # R6-B13: every database reference to an application-managed clinical file, for clinical-asset-reconcile.sh.
# One asset per line, TAB-separated: <asset> <class> <unique> <fallback disks> <SELECT>
#   class     durable: the file must exist while its row does; transient: a workspace file the application removes
#             after processing (its absence is expected and reported as such)
#   unique    1: one row per file; 0: rows may share a file (an import and its published record, a page and its
#             amendment), as long as they agree on its digest
#   fallback  disks where an older file may still live (consent signatures before the move to the evidence disk,
#             files written before the public-disk migration), comma-separated, or -
#   SELECT    returns <disk> <relative path> <sha256 or empty> <branch id or empty>; read-only, no other column
# The SELECTs are checked against the migrated schema by ClinicalAssetBackupTest. Hashes are sha256 of the stored
# bytes (verified in the writers: hash('sha256', <bytes written>)).

column5: SELECT source_disk, source_pdf_path, source_pdf_sha256, origin_branch_id FROM stg_rme_legacy_imports WHERE source_pdf_path IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT source_disk, source_pdf_path, source_pdf_sha256, origin_branch_id FROM trx_rme_legacy_records WHERE source_pdf_path IS NOT NULL

SELECT p.background_disk, p.background_path, p.background_sha256, i.origin_branch_id FROM stg_rme_legacy_import_pages p JOIN stg_rme_legacy_imports i ON i.id = p.legacy_import_id WHERE p.background_path IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT p.background_disk, p.background_path, p.background_sha256, r.origin_branch_id FROM trx_rme_legacy_record_pages p JOIN trx_rme_legacy_records r ON r.id = p.rme_legacy_record_id WHERE p.background_path IS NOT NULL

SELECT p.background_disk, p.thumbnail_path, NULL, i.origin_branch_id FROM stg_rme_legacy_import_pages p JOIN stg_rme_legacy_imports i ON i.id = p.legacy_import_id WHERE p.thumbnail_path IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT p.background_disk, p.thumbnail_path, NULL, r.origin_branch_id FROM trx_rme_legacy_record_pages p JOIN trx_rme_legacy_records r ON r.id = p.rme_legacy_record_id WHERE p.thumbnail_path IS NOT NULL

SELECT source_disk, source_pdf_path, source_pdf_sha256, origin_branch_id FROM stg_odontogram_legacy_imports WHERE source_pdf_path IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT source_disk, source_pdf_path, source_pdf_sha256, branch_id FROM trx_odontogram_legacy_records WHERE source_pdf_path IS NOT NULL

SELECT p.image_disk, p.image_path, p.image_sha256, i.origin_branch_id FROM stg_odontogram_legacy_import_pages p JOIN stg_odontogram_legacy_imports i ON i.id = p.legacy_import_id WHERE p.image_path IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT p.image_disk, p.image_path, p.image_sha256, r.branch_id FROM trx_odontogram_legacy_record_pages p JOIN trx_odontogram_legacy_records r ON r.id = p.odontogram_legacy_record_id WHERE p.image_path IS NOT NULL

SELECT p.image_disk, p.thumbnail_path, NULL, i.origin_branch_id FROM stg_odontogram_legacy_import_pages p JOIN stg_odontogram_legacy_imports i ON i.id = p.legacy_import_id WHERE p.thumbnail_path IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT p.image_disk, p.thumbnail_path, NULL, r.branch_id FROM trx_odontogram_legacy_record_pages p JOIN trx_odontogram_legacy_records r ON r.id = p.odontogram_legacy_record_id WHERE p.thumbnail_path IS NOT NULL

SELECT 'clinical_evidence', handwriting_path, handwriting_hash, branch_id FROM trx_medical_record_handwritings WHERE handwriting_path IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'clinical_evidence', handwriting_path, handwriting_hash, branch_id FROM trx_medical_record_handwriting_pages WHERE handwriting_path IS NOT NULL
SELECT 'clinical_evidence', correction_page_path, correction_page_sha256, branch_id FROM trx_rme_amendments WHERE correction_page_path IS NOT NULL

SELECT 'clinical_evidence', prescription_canvas_path, NULL, branch_id FROM trx_rme_prescriptions WHERE prescription_canvas_path IS NOT NULL AND prescription_canvas_path NOT LIKE 'data:%' UNION ALL SELECT 'clinical_evidence', doctor_signature_canvas_path, NULL, branch_id FROM trx_rme_prescriptions WHERE doctor_signature_canvas_path IS NOT NULL AND doctor_signature_canvas_path NOT LIKE 'data:%'

SELECT 'clinical_evidence', consenter_signature_path, NULL, branch_id FROM trx_rme_visit_consents WHERE consenter_signature_path IS NOT NULL AND consenter_signature_path NOT LIKE 'data:%' UNION ALL SELECT 'clinical_evidence', doctor_signature_path, NULL, branch_id FROM trx_rme_visit_consents WHERE doctor_signature_path IS NOT NULL AND doctor_signature_path NOT LIKE 'data:%'

SELECT 'clinical_evidence', s.signature_path, s.signature_sha256, c.branch_id FROM trx_rme_visit_consent_doctor_signatures s JOIN trx_rme_visit_consents c ON c.id = s.rme_visit_consent_id WHERE s.signature_path IS NOT NULL
SELECT 'clinical_evidence', photo_path, sha256, branch_id FROM trx_rme_clinical_photos WHERE photo_path IS NOT NULL

SELECT 'clinical_evidence', a.file_path, NULL, COALESCE(o.branch_id, o2.branch_id) FROM sys_attachments a LEFT JOIN trx_lab_orders o ON a.entity_type LIKE '%LabOrder' AND o.id = a.entity_id LEFT JOIN trx_lab_deliveries d ON a.entity_type LIKE '%Delivery' AND d.id = a.entity_id LEFT JOIN trx_lab_orders o2 ON o2.id = d.lab_order_id WHERE a.file_path IS NOT NULL

SELECT 'clinical_evidence', d.receiver_photo_path, NULL, o.branch_id FROM trx_lab_deliveries d LEFT JOIN trx_lab_orders o ON o.id = d.lab_order_id WHERE d.receiver_photo_path IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'clinical_evidence', d.receiver_signature_path, NULL, o.branch_id FROM trx_lab_deliveries d LEFT JOIN trx_lab_orders o ON o.id = d.lab_order_id WHERE d.receiver_signature_path IS NOT NULL AND d.receiver_signature_path NOT LIKE 'data:%'
SELECT 'local', file_path, checksum, branch_id FROM trx_lab_workflow_evidence WHERE file_path IS NOT NULL
SELECT 'rme_refund_settlement_evidence', evidence_path, evidence_sha256, branch_id FROM trx_rme_refund_settlements WHERE evidence_path IS NOT NULL
SELECT package_disk, package_path, package_sha256, origin_branch_id FROM stg_legacy_mass_upload_batches WHERE package_path IS NOT NULL
SELECT 'legacy_mass_upload_private', document_entry_path, document_sha256, resolved_branch_id FROM stg_legacy_mass_upload_items WHERE document_entry_path IS NOT NULL
SELECT 'local', file_path, checksum, captured_branch_id FROM mst_patient_documents WHERE file_path IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT 'local', stored_path, file_hash, NULL FROM stg_legacy_patient_import_batches WHERE stored_path IS NOT NULL
